'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Richards DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' woofagent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
